why: One toolchain for every computer that builds Montana for Android: scripts/setup.py installs exactly this, scripts/build.py builds with exactly this. The core's Rust compiler is the core's own pin (core/Code/rust-toolchain.toml), not repeated here.

cmdline_tools.why: the last revision whose sdkmanager is the SDK's own: 23.0 hands every call to the Android CLI, downloaded at run time unpinned and reporting usage by default

kotlin.why: the Kotlin whose metadata the D8 of build-tools 35.0.0 both reads and writes (it writes up to 2.0.0: Kotlin 2.1.21 still drew 1190 warnings, 2.4.20 more)

webrtc.why: the call engine iOS rings with (webrtc-sdk; Montana-iOS fetch-webrtc.sh takes 144.7559.10, which is not published for Android, and .15 is the newest of the same line). The one library of the build (the word of 06.10.2026: variant A), taken byte for byte by this digest; only its classes and the phone's arm64 library go into the APK

go.why: the VPN wall's engine is Xray-core bound by gomobile, as iOS binds it (apps/messenger/ios/scripts/xray-ios: go 1.26.5 in its go.mod); 1.26.8 is the newest patch of that line at least two weeks old (01.09.2026; 1.26.9 came 08.10.2026)

hev.why: the packet pump between the VPN's tun and Xray's SOCKS inbound, as iOS carries it (scripts/hev-ios, MIT); iOS clones the head unpinned, here the newest release at least two weeks old (27.09.2026; 2.19.0 came 15.10.2026), its submodules fixed by this commit

vpn.why: Xray-core itself is pinned by native/montana-xray/go.mod and go.sum (xray-core v1.260327.0, byte for byte iOS 2235's); gomobile is the golang.org/x/mobile those files name

protocol.why: the core/ at the root of github.com/efir369999/montana_messenger (this folder is apps/messenger/android-dinetpda), pinned by its git tree: the tree RELEASES.md names for core (source commit cb4283c9d221, pull request #58, 26.10.2026); before it, from 97433815677a, this app was built and tested against the tree 4ce3d6705224 (source commit 3848245e308b); upstream's own Android build pins instead its private commit ae36d1f927a7 in a folder 'Montana Protocol', which no one outside the project can fetch
